messages:
sara: Deploybot blocked the staging canary push for redwood/core:2026-03-21-rc1 in eu-west-1 — provenance attestation mismatch across mirrors. Holding the change window.
max: ugh. can you paste the deploybot error?
deploybot: publish failed: manifestlist validation error (eu-west-1)
```
Error: provenance.attestation.digest != mirror.attestation.digest
manifestlist: sha256:abcd1234... index 2 (arm64) -> attestation mismatch
status: RETRYABLE=false
```
jia: does this look like the usual kms timestamp skew we saw last month or a bad attestation from the mirror job?
sara: looks like the mirror published an updated attestation after the manifestlist was formed. timestamp on attestation for arm64 is 2026-03-21T09:10:05Z, manifestlist stamp is 2026-03-21T09:09:12Z.
amanda: change window closes in 30m. We need a decision: rollback canary (pin prev digest) or retag/republish with reconciled attestation.
max: we should avoid a rollback if it's just attestation drift. can we re-mirror or re-annotate quickly? how long to retag+push?
sara: retag+push to eu could be ~12-20m if no additional signing issues. But if mirror CI needs manual fix it's longer.
ops-bot: remembered: previous canary digest is sha256:9f88ee77... pinned by deploy event 1782466000.
jia: if we pin to the previous digest for the canary, we keep the change window stable and buy time to sort mirror attestation. release notes will need to mention delayed multiarch rollout.
amanda: agreed. rolling back user-visible change is worse. pin previous digest for canary only, continue investigation.
max: I'll do the pin and a quick republish of the manifestlist after we reconcile the attestation. tagging plan: create redwood/core:2026-03-21-rc1-eu-fixed -> push to eu registry with corrected attestation, then update canary route in 15m.
sara: filing a short incident timeline in #incidents for the mirror attestation drift. I'll attach logs and notify registry team.
max: actions: 1) max — pin canary to sha256:9f88ee77... now. 2) jia — update release notes and add advisory about multi-arch canary delay. 3) sara — notify registry/mirror team and track fix. 4) amanda — extend change window by 1h if we need to republish.
amanda: ok I'll extend the window now.
max: pin done. deploybot: pinned route staging/canary -> digest sha256:9f88ee77... :white_check_mark:
deploybot: enqueue republish workflow job #4567 (awaiting mirror-team ack)
sara: pinging @registry-team for mirror attestation investigation — can someone triage?
max: thanks. once mirror team confirms, i'll push the reconciled manifestlist and trigger a canary promote.
jia: I'll draft a one-paragraph note for release notes and post it to #product-release before EOD.
ops-bot: reminder: keep provenance records for the pinned and new digests for audit.
amanda: any objections to the plan?
max: none from me.
sara: +1. moving to monitoring: watch canary metrics for 30m and escalate on errors.
amanda: closing thread — will update when mirror-team ACKs. :thumbsup:
